title: 2026年8月 Shunbin 会议跟读
description: 依照 2026-08-10 更新版會議提綱逐句整理；未修改句保留原音頻與學習記錄。
audioDisclosure: 課程使用自然美式模擬真人語音；原有未修改句保留既有音頻，新增與修訂句使用免費美式神經語音。

sentences.english: We think this proposal is excellent and fits our needs very well.
sentences.chinese: 我們認為這次提示的proposal非常棒，很符合我們的需求，
sentences.shadowing: We think this PROPOSAL is EXCELLENT and fits our NEEDS very well. ↘

sentences.english: Thank you very much to the Logic and Shunbin teams.
sentences.chinese: 非常感謝Logic團隊和Shunbin團隊。
sentences.shadowing: Thank you very much to‿the LOGIC and SHUNBIN TEAMS. ↘

sentences.english: We would like to confirm a few points below.
sentences.chinese: 以下有幾個問題想進一步確認。
sentences.shadowing: We‿would‿like to CONFIRM a few POINTS below. ↘

sentences.english: Shunbin’s brand concept says the upgraded product can be used on the body, hair, face, and other areas.
sentences.chinese: Shunbin的品牌概念提到，更新後的產品可用於身體、頭髮、臉等部位。
sentences.shadowing: SHUNBIN’S BRAND concept says the upgraded PRODUCT can‿be used on‿the body, / hair, / face, / and other areas. ↘

sentences.english: Could Logic please confirm whether the product was designed based on this requirement?
sentences.chinese: 請問Logic是否有根據這個要求設計產品？
sentences.shadowing: Could LOGIC please CONFIRM whether‿the PRODUCT was designed based on this requirement? ↗

sentences.english: Our current product is alcohol-free.
sentences.chinese: 我們目前的產品不含酒精。
sentences.shadowing: Our current PRODUCT is ALCOHOL-free. ↘

sentences.english: Could you please confirm whether the proposed formula contains alcohol?
sentences.chinese: 請問目前提案的配方是否含有酒精？
sentences.shadowing: Could‿you please CONFIRM whether‿the proposed FORMULA CONTAINS alcohol? ↗

sentences.english: Could you please clarify what type of mint ingredient is used in the proposal: menthol, mint oil, natural mint extract, or a synthetic mint ingredient?
sentences.chinese: 請確認提案中的薄荷是什麼薄荷，是薄荷醇、薄荷油、天然薄荷萃取物，還是合成薄荷？
sentences.shadowing: Could‿you please clarify what type of mint ingredient is used in‿the PROPOSAL: menthol, / mint oil, / NATURAL MINT extract, / or a synthetic MINT ingredient? ↗

sentences.english: Please also confirm the variety and origin.
sentences.chinese: 也請確認其品種與產地。
sentences.shadowing: Please also CONFIRM the VARIETY and origin. ↘

sentences.english: Could you please confirm whether “④ ハイビスカスエキス” in the proposal refers to Chinese hibiscus, roselle, or cotton rose?
sentences.chinese: 請確認提案中「④ハイビスカスエキス」是指扶桑花、洛神花，還是芙蓉花。
sentences.shadowing: Could‿you please CONFIRM whether “④ ハイビスカスエキス” in‿the PROPOSAL refers to Chinese HIBISCUS, / roselle, / or cotton rose? ↗

sentences.english: Could you please confirm which temperature ranges will be used for the product stability test?
sentences.chinese: 請確認產品安定性測試使用哪些溫度階段。
sentences.shadowing: Could‿you please CONFIRM which TEMPERATURE ranges will be used for‿the PRODUCT stability test? ↗

sentences.english: For example, our Taiwan factory usually test at three temperature levels: low, medium, and high.
sentences.chinese: 例如台灣工廠一般會用三個溫度：低溫、中間溫度、高溫。
sentences.shadowing: For example, / our Taiwan FACTORY USUALLY test at three TEMPERATURE levels: low, / medium, / and high. ↘

sentences.english: We would also like to add two more temperature ranges for testing: -10°C to 0°C, and 25°C to 35°C(minus ten to zero degrees Celsius, and twenty-five to thirty-five degrees Celsius).
sentences.chinese: 我們希望可以增加兩個溫度區間測試：-10度到0度，以及25度到35度。
sentences.shadowing: We‿would also like to add two more TEMPERATURE ranges for testing: -10°C to 0°C, / and 25°C to 35°C(minus ten to zero degrees CELSIUS, / and twenty-five to thirty-five DEGREES CELSIUS). ↘

sentences.english: Could you please confirm whether this is possible?
sentences.chinese: 請確認是否可以。
sentences.shadowing: Could‿you please CONFIRM whether this‿is POSSIBLE? ↗

sentences.english: Could you please confirm the minimum and maximum production batch size at Logic’s partner factory, SANSHO COSMETAINMENT INTERNATIONAL?
sentences.chinese: 請確認Logic的partner factory，SANSHO COSMETAINMENT INTERNATIONAL，每次生產批量的最小量和最大量分別是多少。
sentences.shadowing: Could‿you please CONFIRM the minimum and maximum PRODUCTION batch size at Logic’s partner FACTORY, / SANSHO COSMETAINMENT INTERNATIONAL? ↗

sentences.english: Since we plan to gradually replace the old product with the new one, we may start with smaller production runs in the first year.
sentences.chinese: 因為我們計畫以新換舊，逐步替換舊商品，第一年可能做小批量；
sentences.shadowing: Since we plan to GRADUALLY replace the old PRODUCT with‿the new one, / we may start with SMALLER PRODUCTION runs in‿the first year. ↘

sentences.english: Later, if the new product fully replaces the old one and enters new markets, we may need larger-scale production, so we’d also like to understand the factory’s maximum production capacity.
sentences.chinese: 後續如果完全取代舊商品並開發新市場，則可能需要大批量生產，因此也想確認最大生產量是多少。
sentences.shadowing: Later, / if‿the new PRODUCT fully replaces the old one and enters new markets, / we may need larger-scale PRODUCTION, / so we’d also like to UNDERSTAND the factory’s maximum PRODUCTION capacity. ↘

sentences.english: We would like to emphasize again that the upgraded product does not necessarily need to be an oil.
sentences.chinese: 我們想再次強調，升級版商品的劑型不一定要是油，
sentences.shadowing: We‿would‿like to EMPHASIZE again that‿the upgraded PRODUCT does not NECESSARILY need to be an oil. ↘

sentences.english: It could also be a serum, gel, jelly mask, essence water, or another format.
sentences.chinese: 也可以是精華液、凝膠、凝凍（凍膜）、精華水等。
sentences.shadowing: It could also be a serum, / gel, / jelly mask, / ESSENCE water, / or ANOTHER FORMAT. ↘

sentences.english: The key points are that it absorbs well into the skin, smells good, has good efficacy, and has a long-lasting fragrance.
sentences.chinese: 重點是好吸收、好香調、好效果、香味持久。
sentences.shadowing: The key points are that it absorbs well into‿the skin, / smells good, / has good EFFICACY, / and has a long-LASTING FRAGRANCE. ↘

sentences.english: After trying the reference products and the original product, our impressions are as follows:
sentences.chinese: 我們試用了參考品和原版商品後，感受如下：
sentences.shadowing: After trying the REFERENCE products and‿the original PRODUCT, / our IMPRESSIONS are as follows: ↘

sentences.english: White Flower Oil: It has a very smooth oil texture, absorbs quickly into the skin, and leaves almost nothing behind.
sentences.chinese: 白花油：有很絲滑的油感，吸收很快，幾乎沒有殘留。
sentences.shadowing: White Flower Oil: It has a very smooth oil texture, / ABSORBS QUICKLY into‿the skin, / and leaves almost NOTHING behind. ↘

sentences.english: DECORTE AQ: It feels light and watery at first, but then becomes sticky and leaves quite a lot on the skin.
sentences.chinese: DECORTE AQ：質地是清爽的水感油，很watery oil，但接下來會有黏黏的感覺，最後有很多東西殘留在皮膚上，感覺難以吸收。
sentences.shadowing: DECORTE AQ: It feels light and watery at first, / but then BECOMES STICKY and LEAVES quite a lot on‿the skin. ↘

sentences.english: It doesn’t seem to absorb very well into the skin, so this is not the kind of texture or skin feel we are looking for.
sentences.chinese: 所以DECORTE AQ的oil serum質感不是我們想要的感覺。
sentences.shadowing: It DOESN’T seem to ABSORB very well into‿the skin, / so this‿is not the kind of TEXTURE or skin feel we‿are LOOKING for. ↘

sentences.english: Logic’s partner factory, SANSHO COSMETAINMENT INTERNATIONAL, mentions the following strengths on its official website:
sentences.chinese: Logic的partner factory，SANSHO COSMETAINMENT INTERNATIONAL官網中提到他們的強項：
sentences.shadowing: Logic’s partner factory, / SANSHO COSMETAINMENT INTERNATIONAL, / mentions the FOLLOWING STRENGTHS on its OFFICIAL website: ↘

sentences.english: Would it be possible to explore whether NanoBubble technology could help make the particles smaller, improve the skin feel, and reduce stickiness?
sentences.chinese: 可以請合作廠商運用NanoBubble的強項，使分子更小、膚感更好、不黏膩，或許可以將這個技術運用在我們的商品上。
sentences.shadowing: Would it be possible to explore whether NANOBUBBLE TECHNOLOGY could help make the particles smaller, / improve the skin feel, / and reduce STICKINESS? ↗

sentences.english: Perhaps this technology could be applied to our product.
sentences.chinese: 當然，如果有更好的技術可以應用在產品上，使膚感更棒，那會更好。
sentences.shadowing: Perhaps this TECHNOLOGY could be applied to our PRODUCT. ↘

sentences.english: This is just one idea from our side, and we’re open to other technologies if there are better options.
sentences.chinese: 這裡我們只是提出一個建議。
sentences.shadowing: This‿is just one idea from our side, / and we’re open to other TECHNOLOGIES if there are BETTER OPTIONS. ↘

sentences.english: For the sample formula, please provide an English ingredient ratio sheet, as most of the technical ingredient names are in English.
sentences.chinese: 樣品配方需要提供英文成分比例表，因為成分大多是英語系的專業用語。
sentences.shadowing: For‿the SAMPLE FORMULA, / please provide an English ingredient ratio sheet, / as most of‿the technical INGREDIENT names are in English. ↘

sentences.english: As 2027 is our 100th anniversary, we really cannot afford any delays to the upgrade schedule.
sentences.chinese: 2027年是我們的 100週年，升級進度不容推遲。
sentences.shadowing: As 2027 is our 100th ANNIVERSARY, / we really cannot afford any delays to‿the UPGRADE SCHEDULE. ↘

sentences.english: We would therefore like Logic to give this project a high priority, accelerate the development process, and give us a clear timeline for completion.
sentences.chinese: 請Logic嚴肅看待新品研發和調製進度，加快速度，並明確告知需要多久可以完成。
sentences.shadowing: We‿would therefore like LOGIC to give this project a high priority, / accelerate the DEVELOPMENT process, / and give us a clear TIMELINE for COMPLETION. ↘

sentences.english: We plan to develop a new product every one to two years.
sentences.chinese: 我們未來每 1-2 年會開發一個新品。
sentences.shadowing: We plan to DEVELOP a new PRODUCT every one to two YEARS. ↘

sentences.english: At the current pace, however, we are concerned that the development cycle may be too slow for our future plans.
sentences.chinese: 如果仍依照目前效率，我們認為太慢，也擔心Logic無法配合。
sentences.shadowing: At‿the current pace, / however, / we‿are CONCERNED that‿the DEVELOPMENT cycle may be too slow for our FUTURE plans. ↘

sentences.english: Based on our previous experience working with suppliers in Thailand, the United States, and other markets, formula adjustments and new samples can usually be completed within one week, followed by further adjustments based on our feedback.
sentences.chinese: 依照我們以前與泰國、美國等廠商合作的經驗，調整配方和打樣通常一週可以更新，再依照試用反饋繼續調整。
sentences.shadowing: Based on our previous experience working with suppliers in Thailand, / the United States, / and other markets, / FORMULA ADJUSTMENTS and new SAMPLES can usually be completed within one week, / followed by further ADJUSTMENTS based on our feedback. ↘

sentences.english: At the moment, Logic needs about one and a half months for one adjustment, which is too slow for this project.
sentences.chinese: Logic目前一個半月才能調整，速度太慢。
sentences.shadowing: At‿the‿moment, ↗ / Logic needs‿ABOUT ONE and a half MONTHS for ONE adjustment, / which is too slow for this PROJECT. ↘

sentences.english: The cosmetics market requires us to stay up to date with future trends and respond quickly.
sentences.chinese: 化妝品市場需要快速、實際地掌握未來趨勢。
sentences.shadowing: The COSMETICS MARKET requires us to stay up to date with future trends and respond QUICKLY. ↘

sentences.english: We would like Logic to regularly follow the latest beauty and fashion exhibitions in markets such as Tokyo and Europe, and keep up with the latest market trends, hot topics, industry information, and regulations, so that these insights can be reflected in next year’s proposals.
sentences.chinese: 請Logic經常關注日本東京、歐洲等市場最新的美容展、時尚展，掌握最新的市場趨勢、話題、資訊和法規，並提供明年的提案。
sentences.shadowing: We‿would‿like LOGIC to regularly follow the latest beauty and fashion exhibitions in markets such as Tokyo and Europe, / and keep up with‿the latest MARKET trends, / hot topics, / industry INFORMATION, / and REGULATIONS, / so that these insights can‿be reflected in next year’s proposals. ↘

sentences.english: Could you please confirm whether your team can meet the above requirements?
sentences.chinese: 請確認Logic是否可以做到上述要求。
sentences.shadowing: Could‿you please CONFIRM whether your team can meet the ABOVE REQUIREMENTS? ↗

sentences.english: Unless there is a major reason, meeting times should not be changed or postponed.
sentences.chinese: 除非有重大因素，不可以更改會議時間或延後會議時間。
sentences.shadowing: Unless there‿is‿a major reason, ↗ / meeting TIMES should‿not be changed or POSTPONED. ↘

sentences.english: Any delay in the schedule, target dates, or presentation timing will affect our internal workflow.
sentences.chinese: 日程表、各項目標日程、簡報提示時間如果拖延，都會影響我們的工作節拍。
sentences.shadowing: Any delay‿in‿the‿schedule, target dates, or PRESENTATION timing will affect our internal WORKFLOW. ↘

sentences.english: With our 100th anniversary coming up next year, we have very limited room for delays.
sentences.chinese: 我們的 100週年是不等人的。
sentences.shadowing: With our 100th ANNIVERSARY coming up next year, / we have very LIMITED room for DELAYS. ↘

sentences.english: Samples, packaging materials, and related items can be sent to Taiwan by air freight so that we can try and evaluate them directly.
sentences.chinese: 樣品、包材等都可以用空運方式寄到台灣，讓我們實際體驗。
sentences.shadowing: SAMPLES, / packaging materials, / and related items can‿be sent to Taiwan by air freight so that we‿can try and EVALUATE them DIRECTLY. ↘

sentences.english: We would appreciate it if Logic could confirm whether formula adjustments can be completed within one week and the samples then shipped to Taiwan by air.
sentences.chinese: 請Logic確認配方調整是否可以在一週內調製完成後，寄到台灣。
sentences.shadowing: We‿would appreciate it if LOGIC could CONFIRM whether FORMULA adjustments can‿be completed within one week and‿the SAMPLES then shipped to Taiwan by air. ↘

sentences.english: (If Andy brings this up) We would like to receive enough samples for our staff to test the product.
sentences.chinese: （如果Andy有提出的話）我們希望樣品可以提供足量的樣品以供我們公司的員工測試，
sentences.shadowing: (If Andy brings this up) We‿would‿like to RECEIVE enough SAMPLES for our staff to test the PRODUCT. ↘

sentences.english: Ideally, the quantity should be enough for 10 people to use for five days.
sentences.chinese: 我們希望樣品量可以10個人用5天。
sentences.shadowing: IDEALLY, / the QUANTITY should be enough for 10 PEOPLE to use for five days. ↘

sentences.english: Logic has cosmetics manufacturing and cosmetics sales/manufacturing licenses.
sentences.chinese: Logic持有化妝品製造業與化妝品販賣製造業許可。
sentences.shadowing: Logic has‿cosmetics manufacturing‿and‿COSMETICS sales/manufacturing LICENSES. ↘

sentences.english: Could you please confirm when these licenses expire and when Logic plans to apply for renewal?
sentences.chinese: 請確認許可證件效期到什麼時候，預計何時提出展延。
sentences.shadowing: Could‿you please CONFIRM when these licenses expire and when LOGIC plans to apply for RENEWAL? ↗

sentences.english: The ISO certificate held by Logic’s partner factory, which was previously provided to us, will expire in September 2027.
sentences.chinese: Logic的合作partner，之前提示的ISO證件，是2027年9月到期，請問何時會展延，
sentences.shadowing: The ISO CERTIFICATE held by Logic’s partner factory, / which was PREVIOUSLY provided to us, / will expire in SEPTEMBER 2027. ↘

sentences.english: Could you please let us know when the renewal is planned?
sentences.chinese: 因為我們擔心產品未生產完成或者生產完成之後，
sentences.shadowing: Could‿you please let us KNOW when the RENEWAL is PLANNED? ↗

sentences.english: We want to make sure the certificate will remain valid throughout the production process and that there will be no gap before the renewal is completed.
sentences.chinese: 證件到期未展延的狀況發生。
sentences.shadowing: We want to make sure the CERTIFICATE will remain valid THROUGHOUT the PRODUCTION process and that there will be no gap before the RENEWAL is completed. ↘

sentences.english: For the company under Logic that acts as the seller, what licenses does it hold?
sentences.chinese: Logic旗下作為發賣元的公司，持有什麼證件呢？
sentences.shadowing: For‿the‿company‿under Logic that ACTS as the seller, what licenses does it HOLD? ↗

sentences.english: Does it also hold the two licenses mentioned above?
sentences.chinese: 是否也持有上述兩個證件？
sentences.shadowing: Does‿it‿also hold the‿TWO licenses mentioned ABOVE? ↗

sentences.english: We expect Logic to cover the cost of any raw materials needed for sample adjustments, and we would not expect to be charged for the samples.
sentences.chinese: 調整樣品所需採購原料，應由Logic負擔費用，樣品不能收費。
sentences.shadowing: We expect LOGIC to cover the cost of any raw materials needed for SAMPLE ADJUSTMENTS, / and we‿would not expect to be charged for‿the SAMPLES. ↘

sentences.english: This is how we currently work with other suppliers.
sentences.chinese: 我們目前與各廠商的合作都是如此。
sentences.shadowing: This‿is‿how we‿CURRENTLY work with other SUPPLIERS. ↘

sentences.english: If product information or documents need to be updated due to Japanese regulations or the regulations of the export country, these costs should also be covered by Logic.
sentences.chinese: 因應日本或出口國法規，需要更新商品相關資訊和文件時，這些費用都要由Logic負擔。
sentences.shadowing: If‿product‿information‿or documents NEED to be updated due to Japanese regulations or the REGULATIONS of the EXPORT country, ↗ / these costs should also be covered by LOGIC. ↘

sentences.english: If the product cannot be exported due to licensing or certification issues with Logic or its partner factory, Logic will need to find a qualified factory to produce the goods again.
sentences.chinese: 如果因Logic和 partner factory 的資質問題，導致無法出口商品，Logic需要找到符合要求的廠商重新生產商品。
sentences.shadowing: If‿the PRODUCT cannot be exported due to licensing or CERTIFICATION issues with LOGIC or its partner factory, / LOGIC will need to find a qualified factory to produce the goods again. ↘

sentences.english: Any resulting production costs or losses, product return costs, customs declaration and clearance fees, storage costs, and related expenses should be covered by Logic.
sentences.chinese: 因此損失的生產費用、商品退回費用、報關、清關、倉儲等費用，都需要由Logic承擔。
sentences.shadowing: Any resulting PRODUCTION costs or losses, / PRODUCT return costs, / customs DECLARATION and clearance fees, / storage costs, / and related expenses should be covered by LOGIC. ↘

sentences.english: In addition to the formula, container work should also begin.
sentences.chinese: 除了配方之外，容器部分也要著手執行。
sentences.shadowing: In‿addition to‿the‿formula, ↗ / CONTAINER work should also BEGIN. ↘

sentences.english: If we wait until the formula is finalized before starting, the overall schedule will be too slow.
sentences.chinese: 如果等到配方完成才開始，進度會太慢。
sentences.shadowing: If‿we‿wait‿until the formula is finalized before STARTING, ↗ / the overall schedule will be too SLOW. ↘

sentences.english: The formula and container options can be recommended at the same time, so we can discuss and adjust them together as we go.
sentences.chinese: 配方和容器可以同步推薦、一起討論修正，採用聯動式/滾動式調整，
sentences.shadowing: The FORMULA and container options can‿be RECOMMENDED at‿the same time, / so we‿can discuss and adjust them TOGETHER as we go. ↘

sentences.english: This would make the process more efficient.
sentences.chinese: 效率會比較快。
sentences.shadowing: This would make the PROCESS more EFFICIENT. ↘

sentences.english: If container selection does not start early and only begins after the formula is confirmed, it will delay Shunbin’s design schedule.
sentences.chinese: 如果容器沒有這麼早開始選擇，而是等到配方確認再開始，會拖延到Shunbin的設計案進度。
sentences.shadowing: If‿container selection does not START‿early‿and only BEGINS after the formula is confirmed, ↗ / it will delay Shunbin’s design SCHEDULE. ↘

sentences.english: We would like both Logic and Shunbin to look at some of the bestselling products in Japan and see what makes them attractive to consumers, especially how they respond to consumer needs rather than simply saying “moisturizing.”
sentences.chinese: 請Logic和Shunbin都參考日本市場上熱賣品的商品表達方式，了解它們如何打動消費者痛點，而不是只簡單寫保濕。
sentences.shadowing: We‿would‿like both LOGIC and SHUNBIN to look at some of‿the bestselling products in Japan and see what makes them attractive to CONSUMERS, / especially how they respond to consumer needs rather than simply saying “MOISTURIZING.” ↘

sentences.english: The wording needs to comply with regulations while still conveying a sense of effectiveness and appealing to consumers.
sentences.chinese: 用詞需要符合法規，同時傳達功效感並吸引消費者。
sentences.shadowing: The‿wording needs to‿COMPLY with‿regulations while still CONVEYING a sense of effectiveness and appealing to CONSUMERS. ↘

sentences.english: For example, expressions such as “jointly developed with a pharmaceutical company,” “high-concentration formula,” “overnight absorption,” and “advanced regenerative medicine” can be considered.
sentences.chinese: 例如“與製藥會社一起開發”、“高濃度配合”、“夜間浸透”、“先端再生醫療”等。
sentences.shadowing: For example, / expressions such as “jointly developed with a PHARMACEUTICAL company,” “high-CONCENTRATION FORMULA,” “overnight absorption,” and “advanced regenerative medicine” can‿be considered. ↘

sentences.english: If the topic of a contract comes up, our response should be: we can discuss signing a contract once the proposal has been accepted and we decide to move forward.
sentences.chinese: 如果談到合約，回覆是提案成功後才可能簽約。
sentences.shadowing: If‿the topic of a contract comes up, / our RESPONSE should be: we‿can discuss signing a CONTRACT once the PROPOSAL has been ACCEPTED and we decide to move forward. ↘

sentences.english: If the NDA comes up, our response is that: we are still making some adjustments and will share it once it is finalized.
sentences.chinese: 如果提到保密協議，回覆是我們目前還在調整中，完成後會再提示。
sentences.shadowing: If‿the NDA comes up, / our RESPONSE is that: we‿are still making some ADJUSTMENTS and will share it once it‿is FINALIZED. ↘

sentences.english: Logic previously mentioned nanotechnology in its presentation.
sentences.chinese: Logic先前在簡報中提到奈米技術。

sentences.chinese: 品牌名稱：如果沒有更好的選擇，暫以 HAKUYU 或 LUMINT 為方向。
sentences.shadowing: BRAND name: If there is no better option, / we‿can TENTATIVELY move FORWARD with HAKUYU or LUMINT. ↘

sentences.shadowing: Logo: To‿be designed by SHUNBIN. ↘

sentences.shadowing: Tagline: To‿be developed by SHUNBIN. ↘

sentences.shadowing: Package: To‿be designed by SHUNBIN. ↘

sentences.chinese: Jingle / Music：以白花油公主廣告為基礎，優化調整。
sentences.shadowing: Jingle / Music: Use the White Flower Oil PRINCESS COMMERCIAL as‿the base and develop it FURTHER. ↘

sentences.chinese: Smell：保留白花油似曾相識的味道，並使其更加優雅。
sentences.shadowing: Smell: Keep the‿familiar White Flower‿OIL scent, ↗ / but make‿it more ELEGANT. ↘

sentences.shadowing: Domain: Use the ENGLISH BRAND name or SERIES name, / plus .com, / .co.jp, / or .jp. ↘

sentences.english: Before purchasing, scenario 1: Existing customers and younger office workers around the age of 30 may not have truly tried our product yet.
sentences.chinese: 購買前情境 1：既有舊顧客以及 30 歲左右的上班族等年輕一代，還沒有真正用過我們商品。
sentences.shadowing: Before purchasing, scenario 1: Existing CUSTOMERS‿and‿younger‿office workers around the AGE of 30 may not have truly tried our product YET. ↘

sentences.english: They see information through TV commercials or social media, try the upgraded product in a brick-and-mortar store(retail store) or during a short-term brand event(pop-up store), feel that the scent is good, and then search online.
sentences.chinese: 他們通過電視廣告或社群看到相關資訊，在實體店面或品牌短期活動中試用新升級版商品，覺得味道不錯，於是上網搜尋資料；
sentences.shadowing: They see INFORMATION through TV COMMERCIALS or social media, / try the upgraded PRODUCT in a brick-and-mortar store(retail store) or during a short-term BRAND event(pop-up store), / feel that‿the scent is good, / and then search online. ↘

sentences.english: After seeing positive word of mouth, they decide to buy it or add it to their shopping list.
sentences.chinese: 看到口碑不錯後，決定購買或加入準備購買清單。
sentences.shadowing: After seeing positive WORD‿of‿mouth, ↗ / they‿decide to BUY it or add it to their shopping LIST. ↘

sentences.english: Before purchasing, scenario 2: Consumers may be looking for solutions because of mosquito bites, headaches, low energy, hot weather, stress, or simply feeling uncomfortable.
sentences.chinese: 購買前情境 2：最近常被蚊子叮、頭痛、精神不好、天氣太熱想降溫、壓力大想舒緩，或感到鬱悶不爽快，
sentences.shadowing: Before PURCHASING, / scenario 2: CONSUMERS may be looking for solutions because of mosquito bites, / headaches, / low energy, / hot weather, / stress, / or simply feeling UNCOMFORTABLE. ↘

sentences.english: They search online to see what other people are using.
sentences.chinese: 因此上網搜尋關鍵字，看看別人都在用什麼。
sentences.shadowing: They search ONLINE to see what other PEOPLE are USING. ↘

sentences.english: After seeing many people recommend White Flower Oil, they click into the posts, learn that it is herbal and gentle on the body, and find that it is available both online and offline with good reviews.
sentences.chinese: 看到很多人推薦白花油後，點進去看分享，發現是草本、不傷身，也知道網路通路和實體通路都有，評價也很好。
sentences.shadowing: After seeing many people RECOMMEND White Flower Oil, / they click into‿the posts, / learn that it‿is herbal and gentle on‿the body, / and find that it is AVAILABLE both online and OFFLINE with good REVIEWS. ↘

sentences.english: Before purchasing, scenario 3: Consumers may also discover the product through trending topics on social media.
sentences.chinese: 購買前情境 3：社群熱點話題推送，
sentences.shadowing: Before PURCHASING, / scenario 3: CONSUMERS may also discover the PRODUCT through trending topics on social media. ↘

sentences.english: For example, people may be discussing whether there is a limited-edition White Flower Oil at Kansai Airport in Japan, or whether it is sold in Taiwan, so consumers go to Threads, Facebook, and other social platforms for more information.
sentences.chinese: 例如很多人在討論日本關西機場是否有限量版白花油、台灣是否有販售，因此進一步到 trend、Facebook 等社群媒體了解。
sentences.shadowing: For example, / people may be DISCUSSING whether there is a limited-edition White Flower Oil at Kansai Airport in Japan, / or whether it‿is sold in Taiwan, / so CONSUMERS go to Threads, / Facebook, / and other social PLATFORMS for more INFORMATION. ↘

sentences.english: At the time of purchase, scenario 1: In a brick-and-mortar store(retail store), consumers see an opened tester and the packaging immediately catches their attention.
sentences.chinese: 購買時情境 1：在實體店看到拆開的試用品，第一眼覺得包裝好看；
sentences.shadowing: At‿the time of purchase, / scenario 1: In a brick-and-mortar store(retail store), / CONSUMERS see an opened tester and‿the PACKAGING IMMEDIATELY catches their ATTENTION. ↘

sentences.english: After trying it, they feel it is more convenient than before, non-sticky, absorbs well into the skin, and smells good.
sentences.chinese: 使用後感覺比以前方便，不黏膩、好吸收、味道很好。
sentences.shadowing: After trying it, / they feel it‿is more CONVENIENT than before, / non-sticky, / ABSORBS well into‿the skin, / and SMELLS good. ↘

sentences.english: The shelf also shows eye-catching keywords such as “made in Japan,” “premium ingredients,” “relief for brain fatigue,” “alcohol-free,” “mindfulness,” and “five-sense experience,” together with “doctor recommended” claims and scientific data.
sentences.chinese: 陳列架上有吸引眼球的關鍵字，例如“日本製造”、“頂級原料”、“療癒腦疲勞”、“無酒精”、“mindfulness”、“五感體驗”等，旁邊還有“博士推薦”和科學數據。
sentences.shadowing: The‿shelf‿also shows‿eye-catching keywords such as “made in Japan,” “PREMIUM ingredients,” “relief for BRAIN fatigue,” “alcohol-free,” “mindfulness,” and “five-SENSE experience,” together with “doctor recommended” claims and scientific DATA. ↘

sentences.english: Even if consumers feel the price is a little higher, they believe it is worth the price and works better, so they decide to buy it.
sentences.chinese: 消費者雖覺得貴一點，但認為物有所值、效果更好，因此購買。
sentences.shadowing: Even‿if‿consumers feel the‿PRICE is a little higher, ↗ / they believe it is WORTH the price and works better, / so they decide to BUY it. ↘

sentences.english: At the time of purchase, scenario 2: On the online shopping page, consumers see a detailed but easy-to-understand introduction, expert explanations, and simple diagrams showing when to use the product.
sentences.chinese: 購買時情境2：消費者在網路購物頁面看到內容詳細但易懂的介紹、專家說明，以及使用時機的簡單圖示。
sentences.shadowing: At‿the‿time‿of purchase, ↗ / scenario 2: On the online shopping PAGE, consumers see a DETAILED but easy-to-understand introduction, EXPERT explanations, and simple diagrams showing when to use the PRODUCT. ↘

sentences.english: They see that the product has many uses, the visuals are clear, it is convenient to use, and the design looks good.
sentences.chinese: 他們發現產品用途多、圖示清楚、使用方便，而且設計好看。
sentences.shadowing: They‿see that‿the‿product has MANY uses, the visuals are CLEAR, it is convenient to use, and the design looks GOOD. ↘

sentences.english: With recommendations from influencers or celebrities who use the product, they decide to buy.
sentences.chinese: 加上網紅推薦或名人愛用，因此決定購買。
sentences.shadowing: With RECOMMENDATIONS from influencers or CELEBRITIES who use the PRODUCT, / they decide to buy. ↘

sentences.english: At the time of purchase, scenario 3: When purchasing by phone or mail order, the operator provides a clear and friendly explanation.
sentences.chinese: 購買時情境 3：電話購入或通信販售時，電話接線員說明詳細且親切。
sentences.shadowing: At‿the time of purchase, / scenario 3: When PURCHASING by phone or mail order, / the operator provides a clear and FRIENDLY EXPLANATION. ↘

sentences.english: They also give examples of how the product can be used in different everyday situations.
sentences.chinese: 並舉出貼近日常生活的不同使用情境。
sentences.shadowing: They also give examples of how the PRODUCT can‿be used in DIFFERENT everyday SITUATIONS. ↘

sentences.english: This helps consumers understand that the product is useful in many ways.
sentences.chinese: 讓消費者了解商品很實用、用途也很廣泛。
sentences.shadowing: This helps CONSUMERS UNDERSTAND that‿the PRODUCT is useful in many ways. ↘

sentences.english: There are also several convenient delivery and payment options.
sentences.chinese: 郵寄方式和付款方式都多元方便。
sentences.shadowing: There are also several CONVENIENT DELIVERY and payment options. ↘

sentences.english: This gives consumers confidence and helps them decide to buy.
sentences.chinese: 讓消費者感到安心並決定購買。
sentences.shadowing: This gives CONSUMERS CONFIDENCE and helps them DECIDE to buy. ↘

sentences.english: At the time of purchase, scenario 4: Consumers may ask friends or family to bring it back from Japan, or ask a purchasing agent to buy it for them.
sentences.chinese: 購買時情境 4：託親友從日本買回來，或託代購業者買回來。
sentences.shadowing: At‿the‿time‿of purchase, ↗ / scenario 4: CONSUMERS may ask friends or family to BRING it back from JAPAN, / or ask a purchasing agent to BUY it for them. ↘

sentences.english: After purchase, scenario 1: The product feels practical and fits modern needs.
sentences.chinese: 購買後情境1：產品實用，也符合現代需求。
sentences.shadowing: After purchase, scenario 1: The‿product FEELS practical‿and‿fits modern NEEDS. ↘

sentences.english: It helps reduce stress and ease skin discomfort, and the scent feels reassuring.
sentences.chinese: 確實減緩壓力或皮膚狀況；味道令人安心，
sentences.shadowing: It helps reduce STRESS and ease skin DISCOMFORT, / and‿the scent feels REASSURING. ↘

sentences.english: It is easy to carry, and having it nearby gives consumers a sense of comfort.
sentences.chinese: 產品容易攜帶，放在身邊會讓消費者感到安心。
sentences.shadowing: It‿is‿easy to‿carry, and having it NEARBY gives consumers a sense of COMFORT. ↘

sentences.english: People around them are also using it, and celebrities or idols may use it too, so consumers feel they made a smart choice and bought the right product.
sentences.chinese: 周圍的人也在使用，名人或偶像也可能在用，因此消費者會覺得自己眼光很好，買對了產品。
sentences.shadowing: People‿around them‿are‿also using it, and celebrities or IDOLS may use it TOO, ↗ / so consumers feel they made a SMART choice and bought the right PRODUCT. ↘

sentences.english: Maintain ongoing social media buzz.
sentences.chinese: 持續在社群上有討論熱度；
sentences.shadowing: Maintain‿ongoing social media BUZZ. ↘

sentences.english: Launch limited editions every one to two years.
sentences.chinese: 每 1-2 年品牌有限定品發表；
sentences.shadowing: Launch limited‿editions‿every‿ONE to TWO YEARS. ↘

sentences.english: Update the ingredients of classic products from time to time based on consumer needs to create new interest and discussion in the market.
sentences.chinese: 原有經典商品因應需求不定期更新成分，再創造市場新話題。
sentences.shadowing: Update the INGREDIENTS of classic products from time to time based on consumer needs to create new interest and DISCUSSION in‿the MARKET. ↘

sentences.english: External goal: White Flower Oil, Shunbin, and Logic can all benefit and achieve strong business results together.
sentences.chinese: 外部：白花油公司、Shunbin、Logic三方一起賺大錢。
sentences.shadowing: External goal: White Flower Oil, / SHUNBIN, / and LOGIC can all benefit and achieve strong business results TOGETHER. ↘

sentences.english: Internal goal: Lead the company team forward so that everyone can share in the company’s success.
sentences.chinese: 內部：帶領企業員工大家一起賺大錢。
sentences.shadowing: Internal goal: Lead the company team forward so that EVERYONE can share in‿the COMPANY’S SUCCESS. ↘

sentences.english: For presentation dates and meeting dates, we would like to avoid any postponements, rescheduling, or delays to the agreed presentation and meeting dates.
sentences.chinese: 簡報和會議訂定的日期，如果延期、改期或未按時提示，我們都覺得不可以。
sentences.shadowing: For presentation dates and meeting dates, / we‿would‿like to avoid any POSTPONEMENTS, / RESCHEDULING, / or delays to‿the agreed PRESENTATION and meeting dates. ↘

sentences.english: So we’d really appreciate Shunbin’s support in keeping to the agreed timeline.
sentences.chinese: 請Shunbin務必遵循承諾的時間點。
sentences.shadowing: So we’d really APPRECIATE SHUNBIN’S support in keeping to‿the agreed TIMELINE. ↘

sentences.english: Next year is our 100th anniversary, so we need the next stage of the design work to move quickly.
sentences.chinese: 明年是 100週年，我們希望緊接著的設計案效率要快。
sentences.shadowing: Next year is our 100th ANNIVERSARY, / so we need the next stage of‿the DESIGN work to move QUICKLY. ↘

sentences.english: The current speed and progress do not match the timeline Shunbin previously presented, and we feel it is too slow.
sentences.chinese: 目前速度和進度，與Shunbin提示的 timeline 不一致，太慢了。
sentences.shadowing: The‿current speed‿and‿progress do NOT match the timeline SHUNBIN previously presented, ↗ / and we feel it is too SLOW. ↘

sentences.english: So we’d really like to see the pace pick up from here; otherwise, it may delay our 100th anniversary plans.
sentences.chinese: 希望後面加速，否則會延誤我們的 100週年。
sentences.shadowing: So we’d really like to see the pace pick up from here; OTHERWISE, / it may delay our 100th ANNIVERSARY PLANS. ↘

sentences.english: The brand upgrade design and website design should move forward at the same time, and several concept directions should be provided for review and selection.
sentences.chinese: 品牌升級的設計案和網站的設計案要同步推進，並且要提供多個概念方向供參考和選擇。
sentences.shadowing: The‿brand‿upgrade design‿and website DESIGN should move forward at the SAME time, and several concept directions should be provided for review and SELECTION. ↘

sentences.english: If, after Tuesday’s meeting, we feel that Logic may not be able to meet the project requirements, we would like Shunbin to move quickly to identify an alternative supplier, as previously discussed.
sentences.chinese: 如果禮拜二與Logic會議後，覺得Logic不符合我們的要求，Shunbin需要根據之前承諾，快速找到新的廠商。
sentences.shadowing: If, / after Tuesday’s meeting, / we feel that LOGIC may not be able to meet the project REQUIREMENTS, / we‿would‿like SHUNBIN to move quickly to identify an ALTERNATIVE supplier, / as previously discussed. ↘

sentences.english: This will also allow Shunbin’s design work to continue according to schedule.
sentences.chinese: 這樣Shunbin的設計進度也才能按進程推進。
sentences.shadowing: This‿will‿also‿allow Shunbin’s design WORK to continue according to SCHEDULE. ↘

sentences.english: If Shunbin raises various restrictions related to CBD, our response should be: we see this as part of Shunbin’s responsibility in developing a product that fully complies with the relevant regulations.
sentences.chinese: 如果Shunbin提出 CBD 的各種限定，我們要回覆：這是他們的責任和義務，需要合法合規地研發產品。
sentences.shadowing: If SHUNBIN raises various restrictions related to CBD, / our response should be: we see this as part of Shunbin’s RESPONSIBILITY in developing a PRODUCT that fully complies with‿the relevant REGULATIONS. ↘

sentences.english: What matters to us is the end result: a product that can be legally marketed and that consumers can use with confidence.
sentences.chinese: 我們要的是結果，也就是可以市售並且安心的產品。
sentences.shadowing: What matters to us is the end result: a PRODUCT that can‿be legally marketed and that CONSUMERS can use with CONFIDENCE. ↘

sentences.english: The two products we mentioned use medical-grade related wording very effectively, both on the packaging and in their online communication.
sentences.chinese: 如我們提示的兩款商品，無論是商品本身的包裝，或是商品販售的網頁文宣，都充分應用了代表 medical grade 的相關文字，而且運用得非常靈活。
sentences.shadowing: The two products we mentioned use MEDICAL-GRADE related wording very effectively, / both on‿the packaging and in their online COMMUNICATION. ↘

sentences.english: We don’t necessarily need to use the words “medical grade” directly.
sentences.chinese: 不一定要直接寫 medical grade，
sentences.shadowing: We don’t NECESSARILY need to use the words “MEDICAL GRADE” directly. ↘

sentences.english: We can use other relevant expressions, such as “jointly developed with a pharmaceutical company” or “advanced regenerative medicine,” to communicate the medical-grade concept.
sentences.chinese: 可以用例如「製薬会社と共同開發」、「先端再生醫療」等更靈活、更貼切的文字，作為 medical grade 的變化應用。
sentences.shadowing: We‿can use other relevant expressions, / such as “jointly developed with a PHARMACEUTICAL company” or “advanced REGENERATIVE medicine,” to communicate the MEDICAL-GRADE concept. ↘

sentences.english: If a certain ingredient is pharmaceutical grade, we can also describe it as medical grade.
sentences.chinese: 如果某個成分是醫藥等級，也可以寫 medical grade。
sentences.shadowing: If‿a certain‿ingredient‿is pharmaceutical GRADE, ↗ / we can also describe it as medical GRADE. ↘

sentences.english: For example, alcohol can be classified into industrial, pharmaceutical, and food grades.
sentences.chinese: 例如酒精也有分工業、藥品、食品等級。
sentences.shadowing: For‿example, alcohol can‿be CLASSIFIED‿into industrial, pharmaceutical, and food GRADES. ↘

sentences.english: First of all, we think Shunbin has done an excellent job with the proposal.
sentences.chinese: 首先，我們認為Shunbin的proposal寫得非常好，也很完整地總結了我們的理念。
sentences.shadowing: First of all, / we think SHUNBIN has done an EXCELLENT job with‿the PROPOSAL. ↘

sentences.english: It captures our thinking very well, and we really appreciate the work your team has put into it.
sentences.chinese: 這個提案非常棒，非常感謝。
sentences.shadowing: It CAPTURES our THINKING very well, / and we really APPRECIATE the work your team has put into it. ↘

sentences.english: We’d like to keep the current content as it is and build on it by adding a few more ideas.
sentences.chinese: 我們希望在保持目前完整內容的基礎上，可以增加以下一些idea。
sentences.shadowing: We’d like to keep the CURRENT CONTENT as it‿is and build on it by ADDING a few more ideas. ↘

sentences.english: So rather than replacing or removing anything, we’d like to add the following points to the existing proposal.
sentences.chinese: 請注意，目前的內容都非常好，請務必保留，不要減少。我們提出的idea可以再增加進去。
sentences.shadowing: So rather than replacing or removing anything, / we’d like to add the FOLLOWING points to‿the EXISTING PROPOSAL. ↘

sentences.english: Because we use plant-based ingredients from nature, we could emphasize that the product is gentle on the body and can be used without putting unnecessary stress on it.
sentences.chinese: 因為我們用的都是大自然的植物成分，所以文宣上可以強調不會造成身體的負擔。
sentences.shadowing: Because we use PLANT-based INGREDIENTS from nature, / we could emphasize that‿the PRODUCT is gentle on‿the body and can‿be used without putting UNNECESSARY stress on it. ↘

sentences.english: We would like Shunbin to look further into the benefits of the plants themselves.
sentences.chinese: 我們想請 Shunbin 再去查閱一些植物本身可以帶來的功效，
sentences.shadowing: We‿would‿like SHUNBIN to look further into‿the benefits of‿the PLANTS THEMSELVES. ↘

sentences.english: For example, lavender was believed to help protect against disease in Europe from the Middle Ages to the 18th century, while mint is known for its pain-relieving and cooling effects.
sentences.chinese: 例如薄荷本身的功效；薰衣草在中世紀到 18 世紀的歐洲曾被認為有祛疫病的作用；薄荷有鎮痛、清涼的功效。
sentences.shadowing: For example, / LAVENDER was believed to help protect against disease in Europe from‿the Middle Ages to‿the 18th century, / while MINT is known for its pain-RELIEVING and cooling EFFECTS. ↘

sentences.english: These points could be developed into a plant therapy concept.
sentences.chinese: 這些可以整理為「植物療法」方向。
sentences.shadowing: These points could be DEVELOPED into a PLANT therapy CONCEPT. ↘

sentences.english: The communication can also highlight the stories behind the plants themselves, such as stories about where they come from and how they are sourced.
sentences.chinese: 文宣上也可以強調植物本身有很多故事，例如產地的故事等。
sentences.shadowing: The COMMUNICATION can also HIGHLIGHT the stories behind the PLANTS THEMSELVES, / such as stories about where they come from and how they are sourced. ↘

sentences.english: The classic product is a pharmaceutical product, so it needs to talk about efficacy.
sentences.chinese: 經典商品是藥品，藥品要講療效；
sentences.shadowing: The classic PRODUCT is a PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCT, / so it needs to talk about efficacy. ↘

sentences.english: For the new product, we can express these benefits in a way that is more relevant to everyday life, similar to how Ryukakusan communicates.
sentences.chinese: 延續到新的商品時，可以把療效生活化，例如龍角散的表達方式。
sentences.shadowing: For‿the new PRODUCT, / we‿can express these benefits in a way that is more relevant to EVERYDAY life, / similar to how RYUKAKUSAN COMMUNICATES. ↘

sentences.english: For example, benefits can be expressed in a more everyday way as easing stress and head tension, and linked to ingredients such as mint and eucalyptus.
sentences.chinese: 例如舒緩壓力、頭部緊繃，像薄荷和尤加利本身就有這種功效。
sentences.shadowing: For example, / benefits can‿be EXPRESSED in a more everyday way as easing stress and head tension, / and linked to INGREDIENTS such as MINT and EUCALYPTUS. ↘

sentences.english: Stomach pain or abdominal discomfort can be expressed in a more everyday way as easing physical discomfort caused by tension, such as sweaty palms, sweating around the neck, or stomach discomfort, and linked to ingredients such as lavender and mint.
sentences.chinese: 肚痛、腹痛可以變成舒緩緊張造成的身體不適，例如流手汗、脖子流汗、肚子痛，對應薰衣草和薄荷。
sentences.shadowing: Stomach pain or abdominal discomfort can‿be expressed in a more everyday way as easing physical discomfort caused by tension, / such as sweaty palms, / sweating around the neck, / or stomach DISCOMFORT, / and linked to INGREDIENTS such as LAVENDER and MINT. ↘

sentences.english: Mosquito bites can be expressed in a more everyday way as helping to keep insects away, and linked to plant scents such as eucalyptus and lavender.
sentences.chinese: 蚊蟲叮咬可以改為驅趕蚊蟲，例如尤加利的味道、薰衣草等植物氣味，都可以和防蚊、驅趕蚊蟲的概念連結。
sentences.shadowing: Mosquito bites can‿be EXPRESSED in a more everyday way as helping to keep insects away, / and linked to PLANT scents such as EUCALYPTUS and LAVENDER. ↘

sentences.english: This is similar to the traditional Chinese medicine concept of prevention before illness — rather than waiting until a problem occurs, we can focus on prevention and everyday care before the problem starts.
sentences.chinese: 這也可以用接近中醫「治未病」的邏輯來說明，也就是不是等問題發生後才處理，而是在日常生活中提前預防、提前調理，讓消費者更容易理解產品的使用價值。
sentences.shadowing: This‿is similar to‿the TRADITIONAL Chinese medicine concept of PREVENTION before illness / rather than waiting until a problem occurs, / we‿can focus on PREVENTION and EVERYDAY care before the problem starts. ↘

sentences.english: Swelling, pain relief, and itch relief can be expressed in a more everyday way as soothing and caring for common skin discomfort, and linked to ingredients such as lavender and mint.
sentences.chinese: 無名腫毒、止痛止癢可以寫成舒緩、修復皮膚的大小狀況，例如薰衣草、薄荷等植物成分，
sentences.shadowing: Swelling, / pain relief, / and itch relief can‿be expressed in a more everyday way as soothing and caring for common skin DISCOMFORT, / and linked to INGREDIENTS such as LAVENDER and MINT. ↘

sentences.english: This could include dryness, itchiness, or skin discomfort after irritation.
sentences.chinese: 可以和日常皮膚不適、乾癢、刺激後修護等情境連結。
sentences.shadowing: This could include dryness, / ITCHINESS, / or skin DISCOMFORT after IRRITATION. ↘

sentences.english: Heatstroke and dizziness can be expressed in a more everyday way as helping the body feel cooler in hot weather, and linked to ingredients such as mint.
sentences.chinese: 中暑暈眩可以改為中醫的調理概念，天氣熱就可以降溫，薄荷本身就有這個功效。
sentences.shadowing: HEATSTROKE and dizziness can‿be EXPRESSED in a more everyday way as helping the body feel cooler in hot weather, / and linked to INGREDIENTS such as MINT. ↘

sentences.english: The new proposal should explore more ways these plants can be relevant to everyday needs.
sentences.chinese: 新提案的內容要挖掘植物本身生活化的應用。
sentences.shadowing: The new PROPOSAL should explore more ways these PLANTS can‿be relevant to EVERYDAY needs. ↘

sentences.english: Burns and cuts can be expressed in a more everyday way as soothing skin after irritation, and linked to ingredients such as lavender, eucalyptus, and mint.
sentences.chinese: 燙火損傷和刀傷可以寫成緩解受刺激的皮膚，例如薰衣草、尤加利、薄荷等。
sentences.shadowing: Burns and cuts can‿be expressed in a more everyday way as soothing skin after irritation, / and linked to INGREDIENTS such as LAVENDER, / EUCALYPTUS, / and MINT. ↘

sentences.english: Rheumatic and muscle pain can be expressed in a more everyday way as relaxing tired muscles and easing a heavy feeling in the head, and linked to ingredients such as eucalyptus, mint, and lavender.
sentences.chinese: 風濕筋痛可以寫成放鬆疲勞肌肉以及頭脹的症狀，對應尤加利葉、薄荷、薰衣草。
sentences.shadowing: Rheumatic and muscle pain can‿be expressed in a more everyday way as relaxing tired muscles and easing a heavy feeling in‿the head, / and linked to INGREDIENTS such as EUCALYPTUS, / MINT, / and LAVENDER. ↘

sentences.english: Motion sickness can be expressed in a more everyday way as refreshing the mind, making breathing feel clearer, and easing feelings of nausea, and linked to ingredients such as eucalyptus and mint.
sentences.chinese: 舟車暈浪可以寫成提神醒腦、舒暢呼吸。
sentences.shadowing: Motion sickness can‿be expressed in a more everyday way as REFRESHING the mind, / making breathing feel clearer, / and easing feelings of nausea, / and linked to INGREDIENTS such as EUCALYPTUS and MINT. ↘

sentences.english: Eucalyptus is a plant that supports the respiratory tract, and mint brings a cooling sensation and helps refresh the mind.
sentences.chinese: 尤加利是對呼吸道有幫助的植物，薄荷可以帶來清涼感、幫助提神，也可以和舒緩噁心感、減少想吐的不適感連結。
sentences.shadowing: EUCALYPTUS is a PLANT that supports the respiratory tract, / and MINT brings a cooling sensation and helps refresh the mind. ↘

sentences.english: Shunbin’s current proposal is already very good.
sentences.chinese: 目前Shunbin的提案已經非常好了，
sentences.shadowing: SHUNBIN’S current PROPOSAL is already very good. ↘

sentences.english: We’d like to keep the current content and further develop the plant therapy and aromatherapy aspects.
sentences.chinese: 我們希望保留現有內容，並在此基礎上再進一步補強植物療法與芳香療法的部分。
sentences.shadowing: We’d like to keep the current content and further develop the PLANT therapy and AROMATHERAPY ASPECTS. ↘

sentences.english: This would add more depth to the brand story and also make the concept harder for competitors to copy.
sentences.chinese: 這樣可以讓品牌表達更有深度，也讓業界其他競爭品牌更難模仿。
sentences.shadowing: This would add more depth to‿the BRAND story and also make the CONCEPT harder for COMPETITORS to copy. ↘

sentences.english: For example, the proposal mentions the idea of a protective shield.
sentences.chinese: 例如提案中提到保護盾的議題，
sentences.shadowing: For example, / the PROPOSAL MENTIONS the idea of a PROTECTIVE shield. ↘

sentences.english: Lavender, eucalyptus, and mint naturally have antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, which could support the protective shield concept.
sentences.chinese: 薰衣草、尤加利、薄荷本身就有天然抗菌、抗發炎的保護作用，可以形成保護盾。
sentences.shadowing: LAVENDER, / EUCALYPTUS, / and MINT naturally have antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, / which could support the protective shield concept. ↘

sentences.english: Lavender and mint naturally help ease physical and mental tension.
sentences.chinese: 薰衣草和薄荷本來就能舒緩身心緊繃。
sentences.shadowing: LAVENDER and MINT NATURALLY help ease physical and mental tension. ↘

sentences.english: Mint can help improve focus and reduce fatigue and stress.
sentences.chinese: 薄荷可以集中注意力、減輕疲勞和壓力。
sentences.shadowing: MINT can help IMPROVE focus and reduce FATIGUE and stress. ↘

sentences.english: Lavender and eucalyptus leaf can help improve sleep quality.
sentences.chinese: 薰衣草和尤加利葉可以提高睡眠品質。
sentences.shadowing: Lavender and EUCALYPTUS leaf can help improve sleep QUALITY. ↘

sentences.english: Eucalyptus leaves can help purify the air.
sentences.chinese: 尤加利葉可以淨化空氣，
sentences.shadowing: EUCALYPTUS leaves can help PURIFY the air. ↘

sentences.english: For example, Indigenous Australians have a tradition of burning eucalyptus leaves.
sentences.chinese: 例如澳洲原住民有焚燒尤加利葉的傳統。
sentences.shadowing: For example, / INDIGENOUS AUSTRALIANS have a tradition of burning EUCALYPTUS leaves. ↘

sentences.english: Eucalyptus can also help refresh the mind and provide mild pain relief.
sentences.chinese: 尤加利葉可以提振精神、輕度鎮痛。
sentences.shadowing: EUCALYPTUS can also help REFRESH the mind and PROVIDE mild pain relief. ↘

sentences.english: Mint can help soothe dryness and itchiness.
sentences.chinese: 薄荷可以舒緩乾癢。
sentences.shadowing: MINT can help soothe dryness and ITCHINESS. ↘

sentences.english: For the other new ingredients, we would also like to research the characteristics of each plant and connect them to relevant everyday situations in the same way.
sentences.chinese: 其他的新成分也要像以上一樣，查詢它們植物的特色，應用到生活化情境中。
sentences.shadowing: For‿the other new INGREDIENTS, / we‿would also like to research the CHARACTERISTICS of each PLANT and connect them to relevant everyday SITUATIONS in‿the same way. ↘

sentences.english: We believe cooling will become an increasingly important global consumer trend, so we should explore how to build this benefit into the product.
sentences.chinese: 降溫的議題和降溫的商品，一定是全世界未來的趨勢，所以我們要好好應用在商品上。
sentences.shadowing: We believe cooling will become an INCREASINGLY IMPORTANT global consumer trend, / so we should explore how to build this benefit into‿the PRODUCT. ↘

sentences.english: Mosquitoes and indoor air quality are common concerns in Taiwan, and mosquitoes are also a major issue in Southeast Asia.
sentences.chinese: 蚊蟲、空氣清淨這兩個議題是台灣常見的議題，東南亞蚊蟲也很多。
sentences.shadowing: Mosquitoes and indoor air QUALITY are common concerns in Taiwan, / and MOSQUITOES are also a major issue in SOUTHEAST Asia. ↘

sentences.english: If the product can address these needs in a natural, plant-based way, it can make the product more attractive.
sentences.chinese: 如果商品可以對應到這一塊，而且是植物的、不是化學的，可以增加商品的吸引力。
sentences.shadowing: If‿the PRODUCT can address these needs in a NATURAL, / plant-based way, / it can make the PRODUCT more attractive. ↘

sentences.english: Taiwan and Southeast Asia are hot and humid, so in daily life people often deal with sweating, heat, body odor, and stale air in enclosed spaces.
sentences.chinese: 台灣和東南亞氣候炎熱潮濕，日常生活中容易遇到流汗、悶熱、身體氣味，以及密閉空間空氣不清爽等問題。
sentences.shadowing: Taiwan and SOUTHEAST Asia are hot and humid, / so in daily life people often deal with SWEATING, / heat, / body odor, / and stale air in ENCLOSED SPACES. ↘

sentences.english: If the product can help with both mosquito protection and keeping enclosed spaces smelling fresh, it would be a major advantage.
sentences.chinese: 如果商品能同時對應防蚊蟲和改善密閉空間氣味，會形成很大的優勢。
sentences.shadowing: If‿the PRODUCT can help with both mosquito PROTECTION and keeping enclosed spaces smelling fresh, / it would be a major ADVANTAGE. ↘

sentences.english: Especially if these functions are expressed in a natural, plant-based way, the product will feel more appealing.
sentences.chinese: 尤其如果這些功能是透過植物成分來表達，而不是偏化學感的方式，會更容易增加商品吸引力。
sentences.shadowing: Especially if these functions are expressed in a NATURAL, / PLANT-based way, / the PRODUCT will feel more appealing. ↘

sentences.english: Taiwanese consumers generally see perfume as more of a luxury product, while in Japan and Europe, fragrance products are more commonly seen as part of everyday life.
sentences.chinese: 台灣消費者普遍會把香水視為相對奢侈的產品，而日本和歐洲市場更常把香味產品視為日常生活的一部分。
sentences.shadowing: Taiwanese CONSUMERS generally see perfume as more of a luxury PRODUCT, / while in Japan and Europe, / FRAGRANCE products are more commonly seen as part of EVERYDAY life. ↘

sentences.english: So if our product can also offer a fragrance experience similar to perfume, Taiwanese consumers may see it as a practical product that also offers the enjoyment of fragrance.
sentences.chinese: 因此，如果我們的商品能兼具香水般的香氣價值，在台灣市場就可以被理解為「一個實用商品，同時也有香氣享受」。
sentences.shadowing: So if our product can also offer a FRAGRANCE experience similar to perfume, / Taiwanese CONSUMERS may see it as a practical PRODUCT that also offers the enjoyment of FRAGRANCE. ↘

sentences.english: This gives consumers the feeling that they are getting more value from one product.
sentences.chinese: 這樣消費者會覺得花一份錢得到更多價值，性價比更高。
sentences.shadowing: This gives CONSUMERS the feeling that they are GETTING more value from one PRODUCT. ↘

sentences.english: The medical grade part in the proposal is very well written, and it also mentions our background.
sentences.chinese: proposal中medical grade寫得很棒，
sentences.shadowing: The MEDICAL GRADE part in‿the PROPOSAL is very well written, / and it also mentions our background. ↘

sentences.english: We don’t necessarily need the entire product to be positioned as medical grade.
sentences.chinese: 也有提到我們這個背景。
sentences.shadowing: We don’t necessarily need the entire PRODUCT to be positioned as MEDICAL GRADE. ↘

sentences.english: Even one medical-grade ingredient or technology could provide a credible basis for this concept.
sentences.chinese: 商品中只要某一個成分或者某一項技術用到medical grade就可以了。
sentences.shadowing: Even one MEDICAL-GRADE ingredient or TECHNOLOGY could provide a credible basis for this concept. ↘

sentences.english: For example, distilled water in skincare, a pharmaceutical extraction technology, or a concept inspired by pharmaceutical development could all provide a basis for communicating the medical-grade concept.
sentences.chinese: 例如護膚品中的蒸餾水，或者用到製藥的某一個萃取技術，或者某一個idea從製藥中來，都可以作為medical grade的表達方向。
sentences.shadowing: For example, / distilled water in skincare, / a pharmaceutical extraction TECHNOLOGY, / or a concept inspired by pharmaceutical DEVELOPMENT could all provide a basis for communicating the MEDICAL-GRADE concept. ↘

sentences.english: The concept proposal already introduces the five senses very well.
sentences.chinese: concept proposal有提到五感，寫得非常好。
sentences.shadowing: The concept PROPOSAL ALREADY INTRODUCES the five senses very well. ↘

sentences.english: We’d like to strengthen the connection between the five senses and the product, and explain more clearly how sensory experiences can connect the mind, body, and product with the mindfulness concept in Shunbin’s proposal — a sense of unity between body and mind.
sentences.chinese: 我們希望在concept中可以再強調五感和商品的連結，可以多寫一些如何利用五感的感受、身心和商品之間的聯繫，達到Shunbin提案的mindfulness，也就是身心一如的概念。
sentences.shadowing: We’d like to strengthen the connection between the five senses and‿the PRODUCT, / and explain more clearly how sensory experiences can connect the mind, / body, / and PRODUCT with‿the MINDFULNESS concept in Shunbin’s PROPOSAL / a sense of unity between body and mind. ↘

sentences.english: Through sensory experiences such as touch, we can explore the connection with oxytocin release, while scent can be linked to serotonin and emotional well-being.
sentences.chinese: 可以藉由五感的感受touching，促進催產素產生；
sentences.shadowing: Through sensory EXPERIENCES such as touch, / we‿can explore the CONNECTION with oxytocin release, / while scent can‿be linked to SEROTONIN and EMOTIONAL well-being. ↘

sentences.english: We would like to show how these sensory experiences connect the product, mind, and body, ultimately leading back to the mindfulness concept in Shunbin’s proposal.
sentences.chinese: 藉由聞到味道，在身心一如的狀態下產生血清素，分泌催產素和血清素，促使身體達到身心一如的感覺。
sentences.shadowing: We‿would‿like to show how these sensory EXPERIENCES connect the PRODUCT, / mind, / and body, / ultimately leading back to‿the MINDFULNESS concept in Shunbin’s PROPOSAL. ↘

sentences.english: It would be helpful to visualize this process as a simple cycle.
sentences.chinese: 應該將這個促進過程用一個cycle形象地表述出來。
sentences.shadowing: It would be HELPFUL to VISUALIZE this PROCESS as a simple cycle. ↘
